name: academic-students
description: A complete study toolkit for Claude, for undergraduate, master's and PhD students in any degree: assignment coaching and group-work splitting, an honest professor-style grade estimate, academic writing with real citations, exam prep from past exams, lecture summaries, a study planner, read-only Moodle/Canvas/Blackboard sync, right-to-left writing, and a scanner for hidden AI traps in course files. Never submits, never answers quizzes, never stores a password.
